newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'shita Elec to double production capacity of LCDs.
newsitem.headline: M'shita Elec to double production capacity of LCDs.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Friday it would double its production capacity of liquid crystal displays to the equivalent of 170,000 units of 10-inch panels per month.

A company spokesman said it plans to invest about 30 billion yen to convert its wholly owned subsidiary's production facility, which makes four-megabit dynamic random-access memory chips, into a plant to make LCDs.
The plant, in Toyama Prefecture on the Sea of Japan coast, is expected to start producing thin-film transistors (TFTs), the most advanced type of LCDs, next year.
The company said earlier that it aims to boost annual sales of LCDs to 150 billion yen by the 2000/01 business year from 60 billion yen in 1996/97.
